event.summary: Prized announced it was launching Loophole.

sourcePreview.title: Today we’re launching Loophole! An AI onboarding assistant that answers questions, guides workflows, and automates first-week tasks. Hidden during screen shares, always ready in the background. Faster ramp, less chaos.
